name: AMSTAR 2
license_note: Item wording is paraphrased. The official checklist is linked, not bundled.
notes: Sixteen items judged yes / partial yes / no. Items 2, 4, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 15 are the official critical items; the overall confidence rating counts non-critical and critical flaws and is not a worst-domain rule, so no overall judgement is derived here. Judgements are entered by reviewers; the tool never infers them from the signalling answers.

domains.name: PICO in question and criteria
domains.short_prompt: Whether the review question and inclusion criteria name population, intervention, comparator, and outcome.

domains.name: Priori protocol
domains.short_prompt: Whether methods were established before the review began and deviations were explained. Critical item.

domains.name: Justified study designs
domains.short_prompt: Whether the explanation for which study designs were eligible is justified.

domains.name: Comprehensive search
domains.short_prompt: Whether the search strategy is comprehensive (multiple databases, grey literature, appropriate years and language restrictions). Critical item.

domains.name: Duplicate study selection
domains.short_prompt: Whether study selection was performed in at least duplicate.

domains.name: Duplicate data extraction
domains.short_prompt: Whether data extraction was performed in at least duplicate.

domains.name: Justified exclusions
domains.short_prompt: Whether a list of excluded studies with justifications is provided. Critical item.

domains.name: Adequate study characteristics
domains.short_prompt: Whether included studies are described in adequate detail (PICO, design, funding sources).

domains.name: Satisfactory RoB appraisal
domains.short_prompt: Whether a satisfactory technique was used to assess risk of bias in the included studies. Critical item.

domains.name: Funding of included studies
domains.short_prompt: Whether the sources of funding of the included studies are reported.

domains.name: Appropriate meta-analysis methods
domains.short_prompt: If a meta-analysis was performed, whether the pooling methods are appropriate. Critical item; answer without meta-analysis from the report's statement.

domains.name: Explained heterogeneity
domains.short_prompt: If a meta-analysis was performed, whether likely important sources of heterogeneity are explored and discussed.

domains.name: Assessed publication bias
domains.short_prompt: If a meta-analysis was performed, whether the likelihood of publication bias is assessed. Critical item.

domains.name: Discussion of results
domains.short_prompt: Whether results are discussed in terms of bias, both in the primary studies and in the review process.

domains.name: RoB as explanations
domains.short_prompt: Whether the authors used RoB of included studies when interpreting or discussing results. Critical item.

domains.name: Conflicts of interest
domains.short_prompt: Whether the review reports and discusses its own and its included studies' conflicts of interest.
